reasons: Cited Section 21.1–21.3 matches the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and uncapped Excluded Claims covering confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement.
Customer's payment obligation for undisputed Fees is expressly not 'damages' and not limited, satisfying the final preferred element.

The 'Fees' definition covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is meaningful, not illusory; the exclusion of a one-time implementation charge is correctly noted as immaterial given the USD 1,000,000 floor rather than flagged.
Compliant status is consistent with the output: no redline (redline text is identical to original) and no counterparty comment, as expected for a compliant finding.
Deterministic checks both pass and no one-sided or unlimited-Customer-liability language is present.
